Skills.Name: Pyromancy
Skills.Description: Fire mastery. Heat-element spells deal +25% damage when the target is already Burning. Pair with FireBolt, FlamingHands, Kindle, or a flaming-sword proc to set the target alight first, then follow up with a fire spell for the bonus.

Powers.Name: Cinder
Powers.Description: +33% direct Fire/Heat spell damage to Charred targets. Applies to matching damaging rites too, after consumed marks are removed. Charred can come from burnt material or certain preparations; ordinary Burning expiry does not leave it automatically.

Powers.Name: Charsplit
Powers.Description: +50% melee damage on Charred targets, applied as bonus Heat damage. Charred flesh is brittle — your spells weakened the structure, your blade shears through.

Powers.Name: Scorch Retort
Powers.Description: When an attack on you misses, your fire aura lashes back — 3 Heat damage to the attacker. Reliable retaliation that punishes whiffs.

Powers.Name: Pyroclasm
Powers.Description: Detonate the burning creature or object in the chosen adjacent cell. Consumes its Burning; every creature within radius 1 of it takes 3 times the consumed duration in Heat damage. Companions can be caught; you are spared. Cooldown 40.

Powers.Name: Heart Flame
Powers.Description: Spend half your current HP. Your next 3 Fire/Heat damage spells within 5 of your turns gain +100% base direct damage on every target. One charge per cast; fully resisted hits still spend it. Utility and empty casts keep charges but use the time window. Cooldown 100.

Powers.Name: Flame Jet
Powers.Description: Cone 3: direct Heat damage and heavy Burning on creatures, plus fire on the ground. Wet targets resist ignition. Can hit companions. Firing into empty terrain still costs a turn and cooldown.

Powers.Name: Ember Spit
Powers.Description: Cheap filler: 1 target, light Burning, short cooldown.

Powers.Name: Backdraft
Powers.Description: Cone 2: Heat damage, Burning and a shove, with fire on the ground. Can hit companions. Firing into empty terrain still costs a turn and cooldown.

Powers.Name: Oilmark
Powers.Description: Lays oil across 4 cells. No damage — it is fuel.

Powers.Name: Kindle
Powers.Description: A hot bolt whose whole purpose is ignition. 1d4 Fire at range 5, cooldown 6, and enough direct heat (600J) to light dry tinder in one hit. Also taught by the Kindle grimoire.

Powers.Name: Kindle Flame
Powers.Description: The weakest fire in the game: a gentle warmth pressed into adjacent tinder (flashpoint under 250°). Cooldown 2. A cast that warms nothing is free. Also taught by the Kindle Flame grimoire.

Powers.Name: Ember Vein
Powers.Description: A charged beam that pierces every creature in a 7-cell line for 2d6 Heat each, and pours 300J into everything flammable along the path. Cooldown 12. Also taught by the Ember Vein grimoire.

Powers.Name: Conflagration
Powers.Description: A radius-2 ring of fire: 2d6 Heat per creature, sets survivors alight, and heats every barrel and bush in the wave. Cooldown 15. Also taught by the Conflagration grimoire.

Powers.Name: Flaming Hands
Powers.Description: A point-blank blast of flame into a chosen cell: 1d4 Heat to everything there, fire on the ground (oil lights), 300J of direct heat. Cooldown 10. One of the two traditional starting powers.

Powers.Name: Hearthwarm
Powers.Description: Anchor a gentle warming aura on an adjacent cell for 3 turns (60J per pulse) — thaw a friend, dry a soaked floor, coax a campfire. Cooldown 4. Also taught by the Hearthwarm grimoire.
